branding.title: Brand kit
branding.intro: The org's logo, colours and fonts — one source that feeds the app UI, designer templates and email templates. Changing a colour or a font here changes it everywhere at once.

logo.title: Logo
logo.none: No custom logo — the platform's default identity is used.
logo.minResolutionHint: For crisp printing up to A3, upload an image at least {width} × {height} px (300 PPI).
logo.formatHint: PNG, JPG or WebP only — SVG is not accepted.
logo.ppiResult: Used at full A3 size, this logo would print at {ppi} PPI.
logo.ppiSufficient: Sufficient for printing up to A3.
logo.ppiWarning: Below the recommended 300 PPI — large exports may warn.
logo.ppiInsufficient: Below 200 PPI — an A3 export with this logo will be refused.

errors.rejected_content: This file is not a valid PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the allowed size.
errors.unreadable: The image could not be read.
errors.not_authorized: You do not have permission to upload a logo.
errors.unknown: The logo could not be uploaded. Try again.

preview.cardBody: Explanatory text inside a card, in the colours chosen above.
